rationale: Draft's substantive claims about crash fixes are all grounded: 'The Third Edict fixed crashes with Storm Lance' (chunk 1809869179987885-97), 'Tempest Bell in party play' (1809869179987885-96), 'Merit of Service' (1809869179987885-95), 'Essence Stash Tab on controller' (1809869179987885-94), and 'Ver.0.4.0d addressed crashes with Firestorm' (1821922921809503-57), 'Hollow Palm' (1821922921809503-59), 'Garukhan's Resolve unsocketing' (1821922921809503-58), and 'Xbox client crash' (1821922921809503-56).
